summary: Loads and registers a surface resource by name a2. Rejects a null name, then checks the existing cache via sub_497BA0(a2) and returns the cached result if present. Otherwise resolves the string ID via HashTableIDResolution(a2); when resolution fails it either returns 0 (a3 clear) or formats "Unable to load surface \"%s\"" into unk_7CDE38 and reports it via sub_4986D0 (a3 set). A 20-byte node is allocated and initialized (byte flag 1 at +0, +4/+8/+12/+16 cleared with +8 set to -1, resolved ID stored at +12). The node is appended to the singly linked list rooted at this+0x104 (walking the +16 next links to the tail), the counter at this+0x108 is incremented, and the node pointer is returned. Used by menu/profile/UI bitmap loading paths.

local_names.a3: whether to emit an error when the ID cannot be resolved
local_names.v7: list head / walk cursor at this+0x104

Check the existing cache: result = sub_497BA0(a2).
Proceed only on a cache miss (result == 0); a hit returns the cached result directly.
Resolve the name to an ID: v10 = HashTableIDResolution(a2).
If resolution failed (v10 null): return 0 when a3 is clear, otherwise format "Unable to load surface \"%s\"" into &unk_7CDE38 via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck and pass it to sub_4986D0.
Read the list head v7 = this[65] (offset 0x104).
Initialize the 20-byte node: byte flag 1 at +0, +4 set to 0, +8 set to -1, +12 set to 0, +16 set to 0; v4 = v8.
Store the resolved ID at node +12, then copy the name via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(a2).

Append the node: if the head v7 is non-null, walk the next links at node offset +16 (read via *(*(this+0x114)+0x10) base) to the tail and set tail's next to v4; otherwise install v4 as the new head this[65] (offset 0x104).
Increment the registered-surface counter at offset 0x108 (++this[66]) and return the node pointer v4.
On cache hit, return the cached result unchanged.
